module mod_union_find
  implicit none
  type union_find
    integer :: n
    integer, pointer :: par(:), rnk(:), siz(:)
    logical, pointer :: ntr(:), usd(:)
  end type union_find
  private
  public :: union_find, init_union_find, release_union_find
  public :: find, same, unite, size_of, not_tree, used, is_used
contains
  subroutine init_union_find(uf,n)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: i
    uf%n = n
    allocate(uf%par(n),uf%rnk(n),uf%siz(n),uf%ntr(n),uf%usd(n))
    uf%rnk = 0
    uf%siz = 1
    uf%ntr = .false.
    uf%usd = .false.
    do i = 1, n
      uf%par(i) = i
    end do
    return
  end subroutine init_union_find
  subroutine release_union_find(uf)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    if (associated(uf%par)) deallocate(uf%par)
    if (associated(uf%rnk)) deallocate(uf%rnk)
    if (associated(uf%siz)) deallocate(uf%siz)
    return
  end subroutine release_union_find
  recursive function find(uf,i) result(j)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: j
    if (uf%par(i).ne.i) then
      uf%par(i) = find(uf,uf%par(i))
    end if
    j = uf%par(i)
    return
  end function find
  function same(uf,i,j) result(y)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i, j
    logical :: y
    y = find(uf,i).eq.find(uf,j)
  end function same
  subroutine unite(uf,i,j)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i, j
    integer :: x, y
    x = find(uf,i)
    y = find(uf,j)
    if (x.eq.y) then
      uf%ntr(x) = .true.
      return
    end if
    if (uf%rnk(x).lt.uf%rnk(y)) then
      uf%par(x) = y
      uf%siz(y) = uf%siz(y)+uf%siz(x)
      if (uf%ntr(x)) uf%ntr(y) = .true.
    else
      uf%par(y) = x
      uf%siz(x) = uf%siz(x)+uf%siz(y)
      if (uf%ntr(y)) uf%ntr(x) = .true.
      if (uf%rnk(x).eq.uf%rnk(y)) uf%rnk(x) = uf%rnk(x)+1
    end if
    return
  end subroutine unite
  function size_of(uf,i) result(s)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: s
    s = uf%siz(find(uf,i))
  end function size_of
  function not_tree(uf,i) result(b)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    logical :: b
    b = uf%ntr(find(uf,i))
    return
  end function not_tree
  subroutine used(uf,i)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    uf%usd(find(uf,i)) = .true.
    return
  end subroutine used
  function is_used(uf,i) result(b)
    implicit none
    type(union_find), intent(inout) :: uf
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    logical :: b
    b = uf%usd(find(uf,i))
    return
  end function is_used
end module mod_union_find
program strings_of_eternity
  use mod_union_find
  implicit none
  type(union_find) :: uf
  character(500000) :: s, t
  character(1000000) :: ss
  character(1500000) :: ts
  integer :: n, m, x, i, z(1500000) = 0
  logical :: ok(500000) = .false.
  read(*,*) s
  read(*,*) t
  n = len_trim(s)
  m = len_trim(t)
  ss = trim(s)//trim(s)
  do while (len_trim(ss) < 2*m)
    ss = trim(ss)//trim(s)
  end do
  ts = trim(t)//trim(ss)
  x = len_trim(ts)
  z(1:x) = z_algorithm(ts(1:x))
  do i = 1, n
    if (z(m+i) >= m) ok(i) = .true.
  end do
  call init_union_find(uf,n)
  do i = 1, n
    if (ok(i) .and. ok(mod(m+i-1,n)+1)) then
      if (same(uf,i,mod(m+i-1,n)+1)) then
        write(*,'(i0)') -1
        stop
      end if
      call unite(uf,i,mod(m+i-1,n)+1)
    end if
  end do
  x = 0
  do i = 1, n
    if (ok(i)) x = max(x,size_of(uf,i))
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') x
  stop
contains
  function z_algorithm(s) result(z)
    implicit none
    character(*) :: s
    integer :: z(len_trim(s)), n, i, j, k
    z = 0
    n = len_trim(s)
    z(1) = n
    i = 1
    j = 0
    do while (i < n)
      do while (i+j < n .and. s(j+1:j+1) == s(i+j+1:i+j+1))
        j = j+1
      end do
      z(i+1) = j
      if (j == 0) then
        i = i+1
        cycle
      end if
      k = 1
      do while (i+k < n .and. k+z(k+1) < j)
        z(i+k+1) = z(k+1)
        k = k+1
      end do
      i = i+k
      j = j-k
    end do
    return
  end function z_algorithm
end program strings_of_eternity

solve :: C.ByteString -> C.ByteString -> Int
solve pat text
    | lenT < lenS = solve pat $ C.concat $ replicate (div (lenS + lenT - 1) lenT) text
    | otherwise = solve' lenS lenT $ zAlgorithm $ C.concat [pat, "$", text, text]
  where
    !lenS = C.length pat
    !lenT = C.length text

solve' lenS lenT z = runST $ do
    uf <- newUnionFind lenT
    merged <- U.mapM (\(src, dst) -> uniteM uf src dst) edges
    if U.and merged
    then U.foldl' max 0 . U.map (subtract 1.negate) . U.filter (<0)
            <$> runUnionFind uf
    else return (-1)
  where
    n = lenT
    edges = U.map (\(i, _) -> (i, rem (i + lenS) n))
        . U.filter ((>=lenS).snd)
        . U.indexed
        $ U.slice (lenS + 1) lenT z

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int
zAlgorithm bs = U.create $ do
    let n = B.length bs
    z <- UM.replicate n 0
    zbox <- newZBox
    U.forM_ (U.tail $ U.generate n id) $ \i -> do
        r <- readR zbox
        if i > r
        then do
            writeL zbox i
            writeR zbox i
            extendR bs zbox >>= UM.unsafeWrite z i
        else do
            l <- readL zbox
            let k = i - l
            zk <- UM.unsafeRead z k
            if zk < r - i + 1
            then do
                UM.unsafeWrite z i zk
            else do
                writeL zbox i
                extendR bs zbox >>= UM.unsafeWrite z i
    return z

extendR :: (PrimMonad m) => B.ByteString -> ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
extendR bs zbox = do
    l <- readL zbox
    r <- readR zbox
    let !n = B.length bs
    let r' = flip fix r $ \loop !i ->
            if i < n && B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l) == B.unsafeIndex bs i
            then loop (i + 1)
            else i
    writeR zbox (r' - 1)
    return $! r' - l
{-# INLINE extendR #-}

newtype ZBox s = ZBox { unZBox :: BA.MutableByteArray s }

newZBox :: (PrimMonad m) => m (ZBox (PrimState m))
newZBox = do
    zbox <- ZBox <$> BA.newByteArray (sizeOf (undefined :: Int) * 2)
    writeL zbox 0
    writeR zbox 0
    return zbox

readL :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
readL zbox = BA.readByteArray (coerce zbox) 0

readR:: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
readR zbox = BA.readByteArray (coerce zbox) 1

writeL :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> Int -> m ()
writeL zbox = BA.writeByteArray (coerce zbox) 0

writeR :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> Int -> m ()
writeR zbox = BA.writeByteArray (coerce zbox) 1

newtype UnionFind s = UF { internalUF :: UM.MVector s Int }

runUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m (U.Vector Int)
runUnionFind = U.unsafeFreeze . internalUF

newUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => Int -> m (UnionFind (PrimState m))
newUnionFind n = UF <$> UM.replicate n (-1)
{-# INLINE newUnionFind #-}

findM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
findM uf x = go x return
  where
    go !x k = do
        px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x
        if px < 0
        then k x
        else go px $ \ppx -> do
            UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) x ppx
            k ppx
{-# INLINE findM #-}

sizeM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
sizeM uf = fix $ \loop x -> do
    px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x
    if px < 0
    then return $! negate px
    else loop px
{-# INLINE sizeM #-}

uniteM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
uniteM uf x y = do
    px <- findM uf x
    py <- findM uf y
    if px == py
    then return False
    else do
        rx <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) px
        ry <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) py
        if rx < ry
        then do
            UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ry) px
            UM.unsafeWrite  (internalUF uf) py px
        else do
            UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+rx) py
            UM.unsafeWrite  (internalUF uf) px py
        return True
{-# INLINE uniteM #-}

equivM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
equivM uf x y = (==) `liftM` findM uf x `ap` findM uf y
{-# INLINE equivM #-}

-- | O(n)
countGroupM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m Int
countGroupM uf = U.length . U.filter (<0) <$> runUnionFind uf
{-# INLINE countGroupM #-}

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int
zAlgorithm s = U.create $ do
    let n = B.length s
    z <- UM.replicate n 0
    fix `flip` 1 `flip` 0 $ \loop !start !matchLen -> do
        when (start < n) $ do
            let lcp = matchLen + naiveLCP
                    (B.unsafeDrop matchLen s)
                    (B.unsafeDrop (start + matchLen) s)
            UM.unsafeWrite z start lcp
            if lcp == 0
            then loop (start + 1) lcp
            else do
                flip fix 1 $ \inner !k -> do
                    zk <- UM.unsafeRead z k
                    if k + zk < lcp
                    then do
                        UM.unsafeWrite z (start + k) zk
                        inner (k + 1)
                    else loop (start + k) (lcp - k)
    return z

naiveLCP :: B.ByteString -> B.ByteString -> Int
naiveLCP xs ys = go 0
  where
    !n = B.length xs `min` B.length ys
    go !i
        | i < n, B.unsafeIndex xs i == B.unsafeIndex ys i = go (i + 1)
        | otherwise = i

    | otherwise = solve' lenS lenT $ zAlgorithm $ C.concat [pat, "$", text, text]

    !lenT = C.length text

solve' lenS lenT z = runST $ do
    uf <- newUnionFind lenT
    let go ((src,dst):es) = do
          merged <- uniteM uf src dst
          if merged
          then go es
          else return (-1)
        go [] = do
            max 0.subtract 1.U.maximum <$> U.mapM (sizeM uf) (U.generate lenT id)
    go $ U.toList edges
  where

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int
zAlgorithm bs = U.create $ do
    let n = B.length bs
    z <- UM.replicate n 0
    zbox <- newZBox
    U.forM_ (U.tail $ U.generate n id) $ \i -> do
        r <- readR zbox
        if i > r
        then do
            writeL zbox i
            writeR zbox i
            extendR bs zbox >>= UM.unsafeWrite z i
        else do
            l <- readL zbox
            let k = i - l
            zk <- UM.unsafeRead z k
            if zk < r - i + 1
            then do
                UM.unsafeWrite z i zk
            else do
                writeL zbox i
                extendR bs zbox >>= UM.unsafeWrite z i
    return z

extendR :: (PrimMonad m) => B.ByteString -> ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
extendR bs zbox = do
    let n = B.length bs
    l <- readL zbox
    r <- readR zbox
    let r' = flip fix r $ \loop !i ->
            if i < n && B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l) == B.unsafeIndex bs i
            then loop (i + 1)
            else i
    writeR zbox (r' - 1)
    return $! r' - l
{-# INLINE extendR #-}

    writeL zbox 0
    writeR zbox 0
    return zbox

readL :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
readL zbox = BA.readByteArray (coerce zbox) 0

readR:: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
readR zbox = BA.readByteArray (coerce zbox) 1

writeL :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> Int -> m ()

writeR :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> Int -> m ()

findM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
findM uf x = go x return
  where
    go !x k = do
        px <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) x
        if px < 0
        then k x
        else go px $ \ppx -> do
            UM.unsafeWrite (parent uf) x ppx
            k ppx
{-# INLINE findM #-}

sizeM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
sizeM uf = fix $ \loop x -> do
    px <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) x
    if px < 0
    then return $! negate px
    else loop px
{-# INLINE sizeM #-}

uniteM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
uniteM uf x y = do
    px <- findM uf x
    py <- findM uf y
    if px == py
    then return False
    else do
        rx <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) px
        ry <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) py
        if rx < ry
        then do
            UM.unsafeModify (parent uf) (+ry) px
            UM.unsafeWrite (parent uf) py px
        else do
            UM.unsafeModify (parent uf) (+rx) py
            UM.unsafeWrite (parent uf) px py
        return True
{-# INLINE uniteM #-}

equivM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
equivM uf x y = (==) `liftM` findM uf x `ap` findM uf y
{-# INLINE equivM #-}

solve' :: Int -> Int -> U.Vector Int -> Int

    uf <- newUnionFind lenT
    merged <- U.mapM (\(src, dst) -> uniteUF uf src dst) edges
    if U.and merged
    then U.foldl' max 0 . U.map (subtract 1.negate) . U.filter (<0)
            <$> freezeUnionFind uf
    else return (-1)

data ZBox = ZBox !Int !Int

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int
zAlgorithm bs
    | B.null bs = U.empty
    | otherwise = U.create $ do
        let n = B.length bs
        z <- UM.replicate n 0
        UM.write z 0 n
        _ <- MS.foldM'
            (\(ZBox l r) l' -> do
                if r < l'
                then do
                    let r' = maybe n id . unId $ MS.find
                            (\i -> B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l') /= B.unsafeIndex bs i)
                            (stream l' n)
                    UM.unsafeWrite z l' (r' - l')
                    return (ZBox l' (r' - 1))
                else do
                    zl' <- UM.unsafeRead z (l' - l)
                    if zl' < r - l' + 1
                    then do
                        UM.unsafeWrite z l' zl'
                        return (ZBox l r)
                    else do
                        let r' = maybe n id . unId $ MS.find
                                (\i -> B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l') /= B.unsafeIndex bs i)
                                (stream r n)
                        UM.unsafeWrite z l' (r' - l')
                        return (ZBox l' (r' - 1))
            ) (ZBox 0 0) (stream 1 n)
        return z

newtype UnionFind s = UF{internalUF :: UM.MVector s Int}
newUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => Int -> m (UnionFind (PrimState m))
newUnionFind n = UF <$> UM.replicate n (-1)
{-# INLINE newUnionFind #-}
freezeUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m (U.Vector Int)
freezeUnionFind = U.unsafeFreeze . internalUF
findUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
findUF uf x = go x return where { go !x k = do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then k x else go px $ \ ppx -> do { UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) x ppx; k ppx}}}
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
sizeUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
sizeUF uf = fix $ \ loop x -> do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then return $! negate px else loop px}
{-# INLINE sizeUF #-}
uniteUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
uniteUF uf x y = do { px <- findUF uf x; py <- findUF uf y; if px == py then return False else do { rx <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) px; ry <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) py; if rx < ry then do { UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ ry) px; UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) py px} else do { UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ rx) py; UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) px py}; return True}}
{-# INLINE uniteUF #-}
equivUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
equivUF uf x y = (==) `liftM` findUF uf x `ap` findUF uf y
{-# INLINE equivUF #-}
countGroupUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m Int
countGroupUF uf = U.length . U.filter (< 0) <$> freezeUnionFind uf
{-# INLINE countGroupUF #-}

findUF uf x = go x return where { go !x k = do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then k x else go px $ \ ppx -> do { UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) x ppx; k ppx}}}

solve :: C.ByteString -> C.ByteString -> Int
solve pat text
    | lenT < lenS = solve pat $ C.concat $ replicate (div (lenS + lenT - 1) lenT) text
    | otherwise = solve' lenS lenT $ zAlgorithm $ C.concat [pat, "$", text, text]
  where

    !lenT = C.length text

solve' lenS lenT z = runST $ do
    uf <- newUnionFind lenT
    merged <- U.mapM (\(src, dst) -> uniteM uf src dst) edges
    if U.and merged
    then U.foldl' max 0 . U.map (subtract 1.negate) . U.filter (<0)
            <$> runUnionFind uf
    else return (-1)
  where
    n = lenT
    edges = U.map (\(i, _) -> (i, rem (i + lenS) n))
        . U.filter ((>=lenS).snd)
        . U.indexed
        $ U.slice (lenS + 1) lenT z

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int
zAlgorithm bs = U.create $ do
    let n = B.length bs
    z <- UM.replicate n 0
    zbox <- newZBox
    U.forM_ (U.generate (n-1) (+1)) $ \i -> do
        r <- readR zbox
        if i > r
        then do
            writeL zbox i
            writeR zbox i
            extendR bs zbox >>= UM.unsafeWrite z i
        else do
            l <- readL zbox
            let k = i - l
            zk <- UM.unsafeRead z k
            if zk < r - i + 1
            then do
                UM.unsafeWrite z i zk
            else do
                writeL zbox i
                extendR bs zbox >>= UM.unsafeWrite z i
    return z

extendR :: (PrimMonad m) => B.ByteString -> ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
extendR bs zbox = do
    l <- readL zbox
    r <- readR zbox
    let !n = B.length bs
    let r' = flip fix r $ \loop !i ->
            if i < n && B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l) == B.unsafeIndex bs i
            then loop (i + 1)
            else i
    writeR zbox (r' - 1)
    return $! r' - l
{-# INLINE extendR #-}

newtype ZBox s = ZBox { unZBox :: BA.MutableByteArray s }

newZBox :: (PrimMonad m) => m (ZBox (PrimState m))
newZBox = do
    zbox <- ZBox <$> BA.newByteArray (sizeOf (undefined :: Int) * 2)
    writeL zbox 0
    writeR zbox 0
    return zbox

readL :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
readL zbox = BA.readByteArray (coerce zbox) 0

readR:: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> m Int
readR zbox = BA.readByteArray (coerce zbox) 1

writeL :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> Int -> m ()
writeL zbox = BA.writeByteArray (coerce zbox) 0

writeR :: (PrimMonad m) => ZBox (PrimState m) -> Int -> m ()
writeR zbox = BA.writeByteArray (coerce zbox) 1

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int

    z <- UM.replicate n 0
    vl <- UM.replicate 1 0
    vr <- UM.replicate 1 0

        then do
            let r' = searchR i i

            UM.unsafeWrite vl 0 i
            UM.unsafeWrite vr 0 (r' - 1)
        else do
            l <- UM.unsafeRead vl 0

            zk <- UM.unsafeRead z k
            if zk < r - i + 1
            then do
                UM.unsafeWrite z i zk
            else do
                let r' = searchR i r
                UM.unsafeWrite z i (r' - i)
                UM.unsafeWrite vl 0 i
                UM.unsafeWrite vr 0 (r' - 1)
    return z
  where
    !n = B.length bs
    searchR :: Int -> Int -> Int
    searchR l = go
      where
        go !r
            | r < n, B.unsafeIndex bs (r - l) == B.unsafeIndex bs r = go (r + 1)

-- https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc135/tasks/abc135_f

junkanstr :: Int -> String -> String
junkanstr i s =
    s1 ++ s2
    where 
        l = length s
        i2 = mod i l
        s1 = drop i2 s
        s2 = take i2 s

junkancomp :: String -> String -> Bool
junkancomp s1 s2 =
    if l1 == l2
    then
        any (\i -> s1 == (junkanstr i s2)) [0..(l1-1)]
    else
        False
    where 
        l1 = length s1
        l2 = length s2

func3 :: String -> String
func3 s =

    func2 1

    where 
        sl = length s

        func2 l =
            if q2 == 0 
            then 
                if s2 == s
                then
                    s3
                else
                    func2 (1 + l)
            else 
                func2 (1 + l)
            where 
                (q1,q2) = quotRem sl l
                s3 = take l s 
                s2 = concat $ replicate q1 s3

bubun :: String -> String  -> Bool
bubun s1 s2 =
    if ld < 0
    then
        False
    else
        any (\i -> s1 == (take l1 $ drop i s2)) [0..ld]
    where
        l1 = length s1
        l2 = length s2
        ld = l2 - l1

bubun2 :: String -> String  -> Int
bubun2 s1 s2 =
    inner $ div (length s2) (length s1)
    where
        inner 0 = 0
        inner n = 
            if result
            then
                n
            else
                inner (n-1)
            where 
                s = concat $ replicate n s1
                result = bubun s s2

myround :: [a] -> [[a]]
myround [] = [[]]
myround arr =
    map (\i -> (take (l-i) $ drop i arr) ++ take i arr) [0..(l-1)]
    where 
        l = length arr

    let l_s = func3 str_s

    let count = div len_t len_s

    if junkancomp l_s l_t 
    then 
        print (-1)
    else

    vr <- UM.replicate 1 0
    flip MS.mapM_ (stream 1 n) $ \i -> do
        r <- UM.unsafeRead vr 0
        if i > r
        then do
            let r' = searchR i i
            UM.unsafeWrite z i (r' - i)
            UM.unsafeWrite vl 0 i
            UM.unsafeWrite vr 0 (r' - 1)
        else do
            l <- UM.unsafeRead vl 0
            let k = i - l
            zk <- UM.unsafeRead z k
            if zk < r - i + 1
            then do
                UM.unsafeWrite z i zk
            else do
                let r' = searchR i r
                UM.unsafeWrite z i (r' - i)
                UM.unsafeWrite vl 0 i
                UM.unsafeWrite vr 0 (r' - 1)
    UM.write z 0 n
    return z
  where
    !n = B.length bs
    searchR :: Int -> Int -> Int
    searchR l r = maybe n id . unId $ MS.find
        (\i -> B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l) /= B.unsafeIndex bs i)
        (stream r n)

zAlgorithm :: B.ByteString -> U.Vector Int
zAlgorithm bs
    | B.null bs = U.empty
    | otherwise = U.create $ do
        let !n = B.length bs
        z <- UM.unsafeNew n
        _ <- MS.foldM'
            (\(ZBox l r) l' -> do
                if r < l'
                then do
                    r' <- maybe n id <$> MS.find
                        (\i -> B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l') /= B.unsafeIndex bs i)
                        (stream l' n)
                    UM.unsafeWrite z l' (r' - l')
                    return (ZBox l' (r' - 1))
                else do
                    zl' <- UM.unsafeRead z (l' - l)
                    if zl' < r - l' + 1
                    then do
                        UM.unsafeWrite z l' zl'
                        return (ZBox l r)
                    else do
                        r' <- maybe n id <$> MS.find
                            (\i -> B.unsafeIndex bs (i - l') /= B.unsafeIndex bs i)
                            (stream r n)
                        UM.unsafeWrite z l' (r' - l')
                        return (ZBox l' (r' - 1))
            ) (ZBox 0 0) (stream 1 n)
        UM.write z 0 n
        return z

findM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
findM uf x = go x return
  where
    go !x k = do
        px <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) x
        if px < 0
        then k x
        else go px $ \ppx -> do
            UM.unsafeWrite (parent uf) x ppx
            k ppx
{-# INLINE findM #-}

sizeM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
sizeM uf = fix $ \loop x -> do
    px <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) x
    if px < 0
    then return $! negate px
    else loop px
{-# INLINE sizeM #-}

uniteM :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
uniteM uf x y = do
    px <- findM uf x
    py <- findM uf y
    if px == py
    then return False
    else do
        rx <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) px
        ry <- UM.unsafeRead (parent uf) py
        if rx < ry
        then do
            UM.unsafeModify (parent uf) (+ry) px
            UM.unsafeWrite (parent uf) py px
        else do
            UM.unsafeModify (parent uf) (+rx) py
            UM.unsafeWrite (parent uf) px py
        return True
{-# INLINE uniteM #-}

equivM uf x y = (==) `liftM` findM uf x `ap` findM uf y
{-# INLINE equivM #-}

                UM.unsafeWrite z i (r' - i)
                UM.unsafeWrite vl 0 i
                UM.unsafeWrite vr 0 (r' - 1)
    return z
  where
    !n = B.length bs
    searchR :: Int -> Int -> Int
    searchR l = go
      where
        go !r
            | r < n, B.unsafeIndex bs (r - l) == B.unsafeIndex bs r = go (r + 1)
            | otherwise = r

newtype UnionFind s = UF{internalUF :: UM.MVector s Int}
newUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => Int -> m (UnionFind (PrimState m))
newUnionFind n = UF <$> UM.replicate n (-1)
{-# INLINE newUnionFind #-}
freezeUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m (U.Vector Int)
freezeUnionFind = U.unsafeFreeze . internalUF
findUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
findUF uf x = go x return where { go !x k = do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then k x else go px $ \ ppx -> do { UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) x ppx; k ppx}}}
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
sizeUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
sizeUF uf = fix $ \ loop x -> do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then return $! negate px else loop px}
{-# INLINE sizeUF #-}
uniteUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
uniteUF uf x y = do { px <- findUF uf x; py <- findUF uf y; if px == py then return False else do { rx <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) px; ry <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) py; if rx < ry then do { UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ ry) px; UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) py px} else do { UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ rx) py; UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) px py}; return True}}
{-# INLINE uniteUF #-}
equivUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
equivUF uf x y = (==) `liftM` findUF uf x `ap` findUF uf y
{-# INLINE equivUF #-}
countGroupUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m Int
countGroupUF uf = U.length . U.filter (< 0) <$> freezeUnionFind uf
{-# INLINE countGroupUF #-}

function Zalgo(s)
	N=length(s)
	ret=zeros(Int,N)
	ret[1]=N
	i=1
	j=0
	while i<N
		while i+j<N&&s[j+1]==s[i+j+1]
			j+=1
		end
		ret[i+1]=j
		if j==0
			i+=1
			continue
		end
		k=1
		while i+k<N&&k+ret[k+1]<j
			ret[i+k+1]=ret[k+1]
			k+=1
		end
		i+=k
		j-=k
	end
	ret
end

;;; Rolling hash (32-bit)
;;; Use 62-bit version instead. I leave it just for my reference.
;;;

(defstruct (rhash (:constructor %make-rhash (modulus base cumul powers)))
  (modulus 4294967291 :type (unsigned-byte 32))
  (base 2095716802 :type (unsigned-byte 32))
  (cumul nil :type (simple-array (unsigned-byte 32) (*)))
  (powers nil :type (simple-array (unsigned-byte 32) (*))))

(declaim (inline make-rhash))
(defun make-rhash (vector modulus &key (key #'char-code) base)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MODULUS. KEY is applied to
  each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value.

MODULUS := unsigned 32-bit prime number
BASE := 1 | 2 | ... | MODULUS - 1
KEY := function returning FIXNUM"
  (declare (vector vector)
           ((unsigned-byte 32) modulus)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 32)) base)
           (function key))
  (assert (sb-int:positive-primep modulus))
  (let* ((base (or base (+ 1 (random (- modulus 1)))))
         (size (length vector))
         (cumul (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32)))
         (powers (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32))))
    (assert (<= 1 base (- modulus 1)))
    (setf (aref powers 0) 1)
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf (aref powers (+ i 1))
            (mod (* (aref powers i) base) modulus))
      (let ((sum (+ (mod (* (aref cumul i) base) modulus)
                    (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) modulus))))
        (setf (aref cumul (+ i 1))
              (if (> sum modulus)
                  (- sum modulus)
                  sum))))
    (%make-rhash modulus base cumul powers)))

(declaim (inline rhash-query)
         (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 32) &optional)) rhash-query))
(defun rhash-query (rhash l r)
  "Returns the hash value of the interval [L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (let ((cumul (rhash-cumul rhash))
        (powers (rhash-powers rhash))
        (modulus (rhash-modulus rhash)))
    (let ((res (+ (aref cumul r)
                  (- modulus (mod (* (aref cumul l) (aref powers (- r l))) modulus)))))
      (if (> res modulus)
          (- res modulus)
          res))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 32) &optional)) rhash-vector-hash)
         (inline rhash-vector-hash))
(defun rhash-vector-hash (rhash vector &key (key #'char-code))
  "Returns the hash code of VECTOR w.r.t. the moduli and bases of RHASH."
  (declare (vector vector))
  (let* ((mod (rhash-modulus rhash))
         (base (rhash-base rhash))
         (size (length vector))
         (result 0))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 32) result))
    (dotimes (i size)
      ;; (2^32-1) * (2^32-1) + (2^32-1) < 2^64
      (setq result (mod (+ (* base result)
                           (the (unsigned-byte 32)
                                (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod)))
                        mod)))
    result))

(defun forest-p (vec)
  (declare (vector vec))
  (let* ((n (length vec))
         (visited (make-array n :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))
         (dp (make-array n :element-type 'int32 :initial-element -1))
         (res 0))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) res))
    (labels ((recur (pos)
               (dbg pos)
               (if (= -1 (aref dp pos))
                   (if (= 1 (aref visited pos))
                       (return-from forest-p nil)
                       (setf (aref visited pos) 1
                             (aref dp pos)
                             (if (= -1 (aref vec pos))
                                 0
                                 (+ 1 (recur (aref vec pos))))))
                   (aref dp pos))))
      (dotimes (i n)
        (when (zerop (aref visited i))
          (setf res (max res (recur i)))))
      res)))

    (declare (uint31 slen tlen snum))
    #>snum

      (dotimes (lap snum)

(defun %choose-moduli (mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Chooses two appropriate pairs of moduli and bases."
  (declare ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
  (when rhash
    (return-from %choose-moduli
      (values (rhash-mod1 rhash)
              (rhash-mod2 rhash)
              (rhash-base1 rhash)
              (rhash-base2 rhash))))
  (let* ((rand1 (random (length *moduli-table*)))
         (rand2 (loop (let ((tmp (random (length *moduli-table*))))
                        (unless (= tmp rand1)
                          (return tmp))))))
    (if mod1
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod1))
          (setq base1 (or base1 (+ 1 (random (- mod1 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod1 (or mod1 (aref *moduli-table* rand1)))
          (if base1
              (assert (<= 1 base1 (- mod1 1)))
              (setq base1 (aref *base-table* rand1)))))
    (if mod2
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod2))
          (setq base2 (or base2 (+ 1 (random (- mod2 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod2 (or mod2 (aref *moduli-table* rand2)))
          (if base2
              (assert (<= 1 base2 (- mod2 1)))
              (setq base2 (aref *base-table* rand2))))))
  (values mod1 mod2 base1 base2))

(defun make-rhash (vector &key (key #'char-code) mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MOD1 and MOD2. KEY is
applied to each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value. If moduli
and bases are NIL, this function randomly chooses them. If RHASH is specified,
the same moduli and bases as RHASH is adopted.

MOD[1|2] := NIL | unsigned 31-bit prime number
BASE1 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD1 - 1
BASE2 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD2 - 1
KEY := FUNCTION returning FIXNUM
RHASH := NIL | RHASH"
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2)
           (function key))
  (multiple-value-bind (mod1 mod2 base1 base2) (%choose-moduli mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
    (let* ((size (length vector))
           (cumul1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (cumul2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31))))
      (setf (aref powers1 0) 1
            (aref powers2 0) 1)
      (dotimes (i size)
        (setf (aref powers1 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers1 i) base1) mod1)
              (aref powers2 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers2 i) base2) mod2))
        (let ((sum1 (+ (mod (* base1 (aref cumul1 i)) mod1)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
              (sum2 (+ (mod (* base2 (aref cumul2 i)) mod2)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
          (setf (aref cumul1 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum1 mod1)
                                          (- sum1 mod1)
                                          sum1)
                (aref cumul2 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum2 mod2)
                                          (- sum2 mod2)
                                          sum2))))
      (%make-rhash mod1 base1 cumul1 powers1 mod2 base2 cumul2 powers2))))

(defun rhash-vector-hash (rhash vector &key (key #'char-code))
  "Returns the hash code of VECTOR w.r.t. the moduli and bases of RHASH."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           (function key))
  (let* ((mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (base1 (rhash-base1 rhash))
         (base2 (rhash-base2 rhash))
         (size (length vector))
         (lower 0)
         (upper 0))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) lower upper))
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf lower (+ (mod (* base1 lower) mod1)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
      (setf upper (+ (mod (* base2 upper) mod2)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
    (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower)))

(declaim (inline rhash-query)
         (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 62) &optional)) rhash-query))
(defun rhash-query (rhash l r)
  "Returns the hash value of the interval [L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (assert (<= l r))
  (let ((cumul1 (rhash-cumul1 rhash))
        (powers1 (rhash-powers1 rhash))
        (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
        (cumul2 (rhash-cumul2 rhash))
        (powers2 (rhash-powers2 rhash))
        (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash)))
    (let ((lower (+ (aref cumul1 r)
                    (- mod1 (mod (* (aref cumul1 l) (aref powers1 (- r l))) mod1))))
          (upper (+ (aref cumul2 r)
                    (- mod2 (mod (* (aref cumul2 l) (aref powers2 (- r l))) mod2)))))
      (let ((lower (if (> lower mod1) (- lower mod1) lower))
            (upper (if (> upper mod2) (- upper mod2) upper)))
        (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) lower upper))
        (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower)))))

(defun rhash-concat (rhash hash1 hash2 length2)
  "Returns the hash value of the concatenated sequence.

HASH1 := hash value of the first sequence
HASH2 := hash value of the second sequence
LENGTH2 := length of the second sequence."
  (declare ((unsigned-byte 62) hash1 hash2)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) length2))
  (let* ((hash1-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash1))
         (hash1-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash1))
         (hash2-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash2))
         (hash2-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash2))
         (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (res-lower (mod (+ hash2-lower
                            (mod (* hash1-lower
                                    (aref (rhash-powers1 rhash) length2))
                                 mod1))
                         mod1))
         (res-upper (mod (+ hash2-upper
                            (mod (* hash1-upper
                                    (aref (rhash-powers2 rhash) length2))
                                 mod2))
                         mod2)))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) res-lower res-upper))
    (dpb res-upper (byte 31 31) res-lower)))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) &optional)) rhash-get-lcp))
(defun rhash-get-lcp (rhash1 start1 rhash2 start2)
  "Returns the length of the longest common prefix of two suffixes which begin
at START1 and START2."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start1 start2))
  (assert (and (= (rhash-mod1 rhash1) (rhash-mod1 rhash2))
               (= (rhash-mod2 rhash1) (rhash-mod2 rhash2))))
  (assert (and (< start1 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash1)))
               (< start2 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)))))
  (let ((max-length (min (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash1)) start1 1)
                         (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)) start2 1))))
    (declare (optimize (safety 0)))
    (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 max-length))
           (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 max-length)))
        max-length
        (labels ((bisect (ok ng)
                   (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) ok ng))
                   (if (<= (- ng ok) 1)
                       ok
                       (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                         (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 mid))
                                (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 mid)))
                             (bisect mid ng)
                             (bisect ok mid))))))
          (bisect 0 max-length)))))

(defun map-prefix-hash (rhash vector function &key (start 0) end)
  "Applies FUNCTION to the hash value of each prefix of VECTOR (in ascending
order, including null prefix)."
  (declare (vector vector)
           (function function)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start)
           ((or null (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) end))
  (let* ((end (or end (length vector)))
         (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (base1 (rhash-base1 rhash))
         (base2 (rhash-base2 rhash))
         (lower 0)
         (upper 0))
    (loop for i from start below end
          do (funcall function (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower))
             (setq lower (mod (* lower base1) mod1)
                   upper (mod (* upper base2) mod2)))))

  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MODULUS. KEY is applied to

              (if (> sum modulus)
                  (- sum modulus)

(defun forest-p (vec)
  (declare (vector vec))
  (let* ((n (length vec))
         (visited (make-array n :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))
         (dp (make-array n :element-type 'int32 :initial-element -1))
         (res 0))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) res))
    (labels ((recur (pos)
               (if (= -1 (aref dp pos))
                   (if (= 1 (aref visited pos))
                       (return-from forest-p nil)
                       (setf (aref visited pos) 1
                             (aref dp pos)
                             (if (= -1 (aref vec pos))
                                 0
                                 (+ 1 (recur (aref vec pos))))))
                   (aref dp pos))))
      (dotimes (i n)
        (when (zerop (aref visited i))
          (setf res (max res (recur i)))))
      res)))

(defun %choose-moduli (mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Chooses two appropriate pairs of moduli and bases."
  (declare ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
  (when rhash

      (values (rhash-mod1 rhash)
              (rhash-mod2 rhash)
              (rhash-base1 rhash)
              (rhash-base2 rhash))))

         (rand2 (loop (let ((tmp (random (length *moduli-table*))))
                        (unless (= tmp rand1)
                          (return tmp))))))
    (if mod1
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod1))
          (setq base1 (or base1 (+ 1 (random (- mod1 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod1 (or mod1 (aref *moduli-table* rand1)))
          (if base1
              (assert (<= 1 base1 (- mod1 1)))
              (setq base1 (aref *base-table* rand1)))))
    (if mod2
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod2))
          (setq base2 (or base2 (+ 1 (random (- mod2 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod2 (or mod2 (aref *moduli-table* rand2)))

(defun make-rhash (vector &key (key #'char-code) mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MOD1 and MOD2. KEY is
applied to each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value. If moduli
and bases are NIL, this function randomly chooses them. If RHASH is specified,
the same moduli and bases as RHASH is adopted.

MOD[1|2] := NIL | unsigned 31-bit prime number
BASE1 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD1 - 1
BASE2 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD2 - 1
KEY := FUNCTION returning FIXNUM
RHASH := NIL | RHASH"
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2)
           (function key))
  (multiple-value-bind (mod1 mod2 base1 base2) (%choose-moduli mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
    (let* ((size (length vector))
           (cumul1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (cumul2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31))))
      (setf (aref powers1 0) 1
            (aref powers2 0) 1)
      (dotimes (i size)
        (setf (aref powers1 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers1 i) base1) mod1)
              (aref powers2 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers2 i) base2) mod2))
        (let ((sum1 (+ (mod (* base1 (aref cumul1 i)) mod1)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
              (sum2 (+ (mod (* base2 (aref cumul2 i)) mod2)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
          (setf (aref cumul1 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum1 mod1)
                                          (- sum1 mod1)
                                          sum1)
                (aref cumul2 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum2 mod2)
                                          (- sum2 mod2)
                                          sum2))))
      (%make-rhash mod1 base1 cumul1 powers1 mod2 base2 cumul2 powers2))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 62) &optional)) rhash-vector-hash)
         (inline rhash-vector-hash))
(defun rhash-vector-hash (rhash vector &key (key #'char-code))
  "Returns the hash code of VECTOR w.r.t. the moduli and bases of RHASH."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           (function key))
  (let* ((mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (base1 (rhash-base1 rhash))
         (base2 (rhash-base2 rhash))
         (size (length vector))
         (lower 0)
         (upper 0))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) lower upper))
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf lower (+ (mod (* base1 lower) mod1)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
      (setf upper (+ (mod (* base2 upper) mod2)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
    (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower)))

(declaim (inline rhash-query)
         (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 62) &optional)) rhash-query))
(defun rhash-query (rhash l r)
  "Returns the hash value of the interval [L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (assert (<= l r))
  (let ((cumul1 (rhash-cumul1 rhash))
        (powers1 (rhash-powers1 rhash))
        (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
        (cumul2 (rhash-cumul2 rhash))
        (powers2 (rhash-powers2 rhash))
        (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash)))
    (let ((lower (+ (aref cumul1 r)
                    (- mod1 (mod (* (aref cumul1 l) (aref powers1 (- r l))) mod1))))
          (upper (+ (aref cumul2 r)
                    (- mod2 (mod (* (aref cumul2 l) (aref powers2 (- r l))) mod2)))))
      (let ((lower (if (> lower mod1) (- lower mod1) lower))
            (upper (if (> upper mod2) (- upper mod2) upper)))
        (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) lower upper))
        (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower)))))

(declaim (inline rhash-concat))
(defun rhash-concat (rhash hash1 hash2 length2)
  "Returns the hash value of the concatenated sequence.

HASH1 := hash value of the first sequence
HASH2 := hash value of the second sequence
LENGTH2 := length of the second sequence."
  (declare ((unsigned-byte 62) hash1 hash2)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) length2))
  (let* ((hash1-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash1))
         (hash1-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash1))
         (hash2-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash2))
         (hash2-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash2))
         (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (res-lower (mod (+ hash2-lower
                            (mod (* hash1-lower
                                    (aref (rhash-powers1 rhash) length2))
                                 mod1))
                         mod1))
         (res-upper (mod (+ hash2-upper
                            (mod (* hash1-upper
                                    (aref (rhash-powers2 rhash) length2))
                                 mod2))
                         mod2)))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) res-lower res-upper))
    (dpb res-upper (byte 31 31) res-lower)))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) &optional)) rhash-get-lcp))
(defun rhash-get-lcp (rhash1 start1 rhash2 start2)
  "Returns the length of the longest common prefix of two suffixes which begin
at START1 and START2."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start1 start2))
  (assert (and (= (rhash-mod1 rhash1) (rhash-mod1 rhash2))
               (= (rhash-mod2 rhash1) (rhash-mod2 rhash2))))
  (assert (and (< start1 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash1)))
               (< start2 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)))))
  (let ((max-length (min (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash1)) start1 1)
                         (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)) start2 1))))
    (declare (optimize (safety 0)))
    (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 max-length))
           (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 max-length)))
        max-length
        (labels ((bisect (ok ng)
                   (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) ok ng))
                   (if (<= (- ng ok) 1)
                       ok
                       (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                         (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 mid))
                                (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 mid)))
                             (bisect mid ng)
                             (bisect ok mid))))))
          (bisect 0 max-length)))))

                      finally (let* ((l base)

                                (if (<= dif (* 2 (- tlen 1)))
                                    (progn (println -1)
                                           (return-from main))

              (incf base)))
      #>total-len

        (declare (uint31 res))
        (dotimes (pos total-len)
          (let ((length (rhash-get-lcp rhash pos rhash2 0)))
            (setf res (max res (floor length tlen)))))
        (println res)))))

(defun forest-p (vec)

  (let* ((n (length vec))
         (visited (make-array n :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))

        (powers1 (rhash-powers1 rhash))
        (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))

        (powers2 (rhash-powers2 rhash))

         (hash1-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash1))
         (hash2-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash2))
         (hash2-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash2))

(defun rhash-get-lcp (rhash1 start1 rhash2 start2)
  "Returns the length of the longest common prefix of two suffixes which begin

  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start1 start2))
  (assert (and (= (rhash-mod1 rhash1) (rhash-mod1 rhash2))
               (= (rhash-mod2 rhash1) (rhash-mod2 rhash2))))

               (< start2 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)))))

                         (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)) start2 1))))

           (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 max-length)))

                   (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) ok ng))

                         (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 mid))
                                (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 mid)))
                             (bisect mid ng)
                             (bisect ok mid))))))
          (bisect 0 max-length)))))

(defun map-prefix-hash (rhash vector function &key (start 0) end)
  "Applies FUNCTION to the hash value of each prefix of VECTOR (in ascending
order, including null prefix)."
  (declare (vector vector)
           (function function)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start)
           ((or null (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) end))
  (let* ((end (or end (length vector)))
         (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (base1 (rhash-base1 rhash))
         (base2 (rhash-base2 rhash))
         (lower 0)
         (upper 0))
    (loop for i from start below end
          do (funcall function (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower))
             (setq lower (mod (* lower base1) mod1)
                   upper (mod (* upper base2) mod2)))))

(defun %choose-moduli (mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Chooses two appropriate pairs of moduli and bases."
  (declare ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
  (when rhash
    (return-from %choose-moduli
      (values (rhash-mod1 rhash)
              (rhash-mod2 rhash)
              (rhash-base1 rhash)
              (rhash-base2 rhash))))
  (let* ((rand1 (random (length *moduli-table*)))
         (rand2 (loop (let ((tmp (random (length *moduli-table*))))
                        (unless (= tmp rand1)
                          (return tmp))))))
    (if mod1
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod1))
          (setq base1 (or base1 (+ 1 (random (- mod1 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod1 (or mod1 (aref *moduli-table* rand1)))
          (if base1

        (progn

and bases are NIL, this function randomly chooses them. If RHASH is specified,
the same moduli and bases as RHASH is adopted.

BASE1 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD1 - 1
BASE2 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD2 - 1

  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2)

  (multiple-value-bind (mod1 mod2 base1 base2) (%choose-moduli mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)

           (powers1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (cumul2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31))))
      (setf (aref powers1 0) 1
            (aref powers2 0) 1)
      (dotimes (i size)
        (setf (aref powers1 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers1 i) base1) mod1)
              (aref powers2 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers2 i) base2) mod2))
        (let ((sum1 (+ (mod (* base1 (aref cumul1 i)) mod1)

(declaim (inline make-rhash))
(defun make-rhash (vector modulus &key (key #'char-code) base)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MODULUS. KEY is applied to
  each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value.

MODULUS := unsigned 32-bit prime number
BASE := 1 | 2 | ... | MODULUS - 1
KEY := function returning FIXNUM"
  (declare (vector vector)
           ((unsigned-byte 32) modulus)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 32)) base)
           (function key))
  (assert (sb-int:positive-primep modulus))
  (let* ((base (or base (+ 1 (random (- modulus 1)))))
         (size (length vector))
         (cumul (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32)))
         (powers (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32))))
    (assert (<= 1 base (- modulus 1)))
    (setf (aref powers 0) 1)
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf (aref powers (+ i 1))
            (mod (* (aref powers i) base) modulus))
      (let ((sum (+ (mod (* (aref cumul i) base) modulus)
                    (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) modulus))))
        (setf (aref cumul (+ i 1))
              (if (> sum modulus)
                  (- sum modulus)
                  sum))))
    (%make-rhash modulus base cumul powers)))

(defun rhash-query (rhash l r)
  "Returns the hash value of the interval [L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (let ((cumul (rhash-cumul rhash))
        (powers (rhash-powers rhash))
        (modulus (rhash-modulus rhash)))
    (let ((res (+ (aref cumul r)
                  (- modulus (mod (* (aref cumul l) (aref powers (- r l))) modulus)))))
      (if (> res modulus)
          (- res modulus)
          res))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 32) &optional)) rhash-vector-hash)

(defun rhash-vector-hash (rhash vector &key (key #'char-code))
  "Returns the hash code of VECTOR w.r.t. the moduli and bases of RHASH."
  (declare (vector vector))
  (let* ((mod (rhash-modulus rhash))
         (base (rhash-base rhash))
         (size (length vector))
         (result 0))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 32) result))
    (dotimes (i size)
      ;; (2^32-1) * (2^32-1) + (2^32-1) < 2^64
      (setq result (mod (+ (* base result)
                           (the (unsigned-byte 32)
                                (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod)))

    result))

(defun forest-p (vec)
  (declare (vector vec))
  (let* ((n (length vec))
         (visited (make-array n :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))
         (dp (make-array n :element-type 'int32 :initial-element -1))
         (res 0))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) res))
    (labels ((recur (pos)
               (if (= -1 (aref dp pos))
                   (if (= 1 (aref visited pos))
                       (return-from forest-p nil)
                       (setf (aref visited pos) 1
                             (aref dp pos)
                             (if (= -1 (aref vec pos))
                                 0
                                 (+ 1 (recur (aref vec pos))))))
                   (aref dp pos))))
      (dotimes (i n)
        (when (zerop (aref visited i))
          (setf res (max res (recur i)))))
      res)))

(defun make-rhash (vector &key (key #'char-code) mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MOD1 and MOD2. KEY is
applied to each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value. If moduli
and bases are NIL, this function randomly chooses them. If RHASH is specified,
the same moduli and bases as RHASH is adopted.

MOD[1|2] := NIL | unsigned 31-bit prime number
BASE1 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD1 - 1
BASE2 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD2 - 1
KEY := FUNCTION returning FIXNUM
RHASH := NIL | RHASH"
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2)
           (function key))
  (multiple-value-bind (mod1 mod2 base1 base2) (%choose-moduli mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
    (let* ((size (length vector))
           (cumul1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (cumul2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31))))
      (setf (aref powers1 0) 1
            (aref powers2 0) 1)
      (dotimes (i size)
        (setf (aref powers1 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers1 i) base1) mod1)
              (aref powers2 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers2 i) base2) mod2))
        (let ((sum1 (+ (mod (* base1 (aref cumul1 i)) mod1)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
              (sum2 (+ (mod (* base2 (aref cumul2 i)) mod2)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
          (setf (aref cumul1 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum1 mod1)
                                          (- sum1 mod1)
                                          sum1)
                (aref cumul2 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum2 mod2)
                                          (- sum2 mod2)
                                          sum2))))
      (%make-rhash mod1 base1 cumul1 powers1 mod2 base2 cumul2 powers2))))

(defun rhash-vector-hash (rhash vector &key (key #'char-code))
  "Returns the hash code of VECTOR w.r.t. the moduli and bases of RHASH."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           (function key))
  (let* ((mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (base1 (rhash-base1 rhash))
         (base2 (rhash-base2 rhash))
         (size (length vector))
         (lower 0)
         (upper 0))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) lower upper))
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf lower (+ (mod (* base1 lower) mod1)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
      (setf upper (+ (mod (* base2 upper) mod2)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
    (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower)))

(declaim (inline rhash-query)
         (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 62) &optional)) rhash-query))
(defun rhash-query (rhash l r)
  "Returns the hash value of the interval [L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (assert (<= l r))
  (let ((cumul1 (rhash-cumul1 rhash))
        (powers1 (rhash-powers1 rhash))
        (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
        (cumul2 (rhash-cumul2 rhash))
        (powers2 (rhash-powers2 rhash))
        (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash)))
    (let ((lower (+ (aref cumul1 r)
                    (- mod1 (mod (* (aref cumul1 l) (aref powers1 (- r l))) mod1))))
          (upper (+ (aref cumul2 r)
                    (- mod2 (mod (* (aref cumul2 l) (aref powers2 (- r l))) mod2)))))
      (let ((lower (if (> lower mod1) (- lower mod1) lower))
            (upper (if (> upper mod2) (- upper mod2) upper)))
        (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) lower upper))
        (dpb upper (byte 31 31) lower)))))

(declaim (inline rhash-concat))
(defun rhash-concat (rhash hash1 hash2 length2)
  "Returns the hash value of the concatenated sequence.

HASH1 := hash value of the first sequence
HASH2 := hash value of the second sequence
LENGTH2 := length of the second sequence."
  (declare ((unsigned-byte 62) hash1 hash2)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) length2))
  (let* ((hash1-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash1))
         (hash1-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash1))
         (hash2-lower (ldb (byte 31 0) hash2))
         (hash2-upper (ldb (byte 31 31) hash2))
         (mod1 (rhash-mod1 rhash))
         (mod2 (rhash-mod2 rhash))
         (res-lower (mod (+ hash2-lower
                            (mod (* hash1-lower
                                    (aref (rhash-powers1 rhash) length2))
                                 mod1))
                         mod1))
         (res-upper (mod (+ hash2-upper
                            (mod (* hash1-upper
                                    (aref (rhash-powers2 rhash) length2))
                                 mod2))
                         mod2)))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) res-lower res-upper))
    (dpb res-upper (byte 31 31) res-lower)))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) &optional)) rhash-get-lcp))
(defun rhash-get-lcp (rhash1 start1 rhash2 start2)
  "Returns the length of the longest common prefix of two suffixes which begin
at START1 and START2."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start1 start2))
  (assert (and (= (rhash-mod1 rhash1) (rhash-mod1 rhash2))
               (= (rhash-mod2 rhash1) (rhash-mod2 rhash2))))
  (assert (and (< start1 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash1)))
               (< start2 (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)))))
  (let ((max-length (min (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash1)) start1 1)
                         (- (length (rhash-cumul1 rhash2)) start2 1))))
    (declare (optimize (safety 0)))
    (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 max-length))
           (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 max-length)))
        max-length
        (labels ((bisect (ok ng)
                   (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) ok ng))
                   (if (<= (- ng ok) 1)
                       ok
                       (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                         (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 mid))
                                (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 mid)))
                             (bisect mid ng)
                             (bisect ok mid))))))
          (bisect 0 max-length)))))

                ;; possibly infinite

                      finally (let* ((l base)

        #>ex-ss

        (dotimes (pos total-len)

(defun %choose-moduli (mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Chooses two appropriate pairs of moduli and bases."
  (declare ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
  (when rhash
    (return-from %choose-moduli
      (values (rhash-mod1 rhash)
              (rhash-mod2 rhash)
              (rhash-base1 rhash)
              (rhash-base2 rhash))))
  (let* ((rand1 (random (length *moduli-table*)))
         (rand2 (loop (let ((tmp (random (length *moduli-table*))))
                        (unless (= tmp rand1)
                          (return tmp))))))
    (if mod1
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod1))
          (setq base1 (or base1 (+ 1 (random (- mod1 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod1 (or mod1 (aref *moduli-table* rand1)))
          (if base1
              (assert (<= 1 base1 (- mod1 1)))
              (setq base1 (aref *base-table* rand1)))))
    (if mod2
        (progn
          (assert (sb-int:positive-primep mod2))
          (setq base2 (or base2 (+ 1 (random (- mod2 1))))))
        (progn
          (setq mod2 (or mod2 (aref *moduli-table* rand2)))
          (if base2
              (assert (<= 1 base2 (- mod2 1)))
              (setq base2 (aref *base-table* rand2))))))
  (values mod1 mod2 base1 base2))

(defun make-rhash (vector &key (key #'char-code) mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MOD1 and MOD2. KEY is
applied to each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value. If moduli
and bases are NIL, this function randomly chooses them. If RHASH is specified,
the same moduli and bases as RHASH is adopted.

MOD[1|2] := NIL | unsigned 31-bit prime number
BASE1 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD1 - 1
BASE2 := NIL | 1 | 2 | ... | MOD2 - 1
KEY := FUNCTION returning FIXNUM
RHASH := NIL | RHASH"
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 31)) mod1 mod2 base1 base2)
           (function key))
  (multiple-value-bind (mod1 mod2 base1 base2) (%choose-moduli mod1 mod2 base1 base2 rhash)
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 31) mod1 mod2 base1 base2))
    (let* ((size (length vector))
           (cumul1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers1 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (cumul2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31)))
           (powers2 (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31))))
      (setf (aref powers1 0) 1
            (aref powers2 0) 1)
      (dotimes (i size)
        (setf (aref powers1 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers1 i) base1) mod1)
              (aref powers2 (+ i 1))
              (mod (* (aref powers2 i) base2) mod2))
        (let ((sum1 (+ (mod (* base1 (aref cumul1 i)) mod1)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod1)))
              (sum2 (+ (mod (* base2 (aref cumul2 i)) mod2)
                       (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod2))))
          (setf (aref cumul1 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum1 mod1)
                                          (- sum1 mod1)
                                          sum1)
                (aref cumul2 (+ i 1)) (if (> sum2 mod2)
                                          (- sum2 mod2)
                                          sum2))))
      (%make-rhash mod1 base1 cumul1 powers1 mod2 base2 cumul2 powers2))))

(defstruct (rhash (:constructor %make-rhash (modulus cumul powers)))
  (modulus 1000000007 :type (unsigned-byte 32))
  (cumul nil :type (simple-array (unsigned-byte 32) (*)))
  (powers nil :type (simple-array (unsigned-byte 32) (*))))

(declaim (inline make-rhash))
(defun make-rhash (vector modulus &key (key #'char-code) base)
  "Returns the table of rolling-hash of VECTOR modulo MODULUS. KEY is applied to
  each element of VECTOR prior to computing the hash value.

MODULUS := unsigned 32-bit prime number
BASE := 1 | 2 | ... | MODULUS - 1
KEY := function returning FIXNUM"
  (declare (vector vector)
           ((unsigned-byte 32) modulus)
           ((or null (unsigned-byte 32)) base)
           (function key))
  (assert (sb-int:positive-primep modulus))
  (let* ((base (or base (+ 1 (random (- modulus 1)))))
         (size (length vector))
         (cumul (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32)))
         (powers (make-array (+ 1 size) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32))))
    (assert (<= 1 base (- modulus 1)))
    (setf (aref powers 0) 1)
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf (aref powers (+ i 1))
            (mod (* (aref powers i) base) modulus))
      (let ((sum (+ (mod (* (aref cumul i) base) modulus)
                    (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) modulus))))
        (setf (aref cumul (+ i 1))
              (if (> sum modulus)
                  (- sum modulus)
                  sum))))
    (%make-rhash modulus cumul powers)))

(declaim (inline rhash-query)
         (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 32) &optional)) rhash-query))
(defun rhash-query (rhash l r)
  "Returns the hash value of the interval [L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (assert (<= l r))
  (let ((cumul (rhash-cumul rhash))
        (powers (rhash-powers rhash))
        (modulus (rhash-modulus rhash)))
    (let ((res (+ (aref cumul r)
                  (- modulus (mod (* (aref cumul l) (aref powers (- r l))) modulus)))))
      (if (> res modulus)
          (- res modulus)
          res))))

(declaim (inline rhash-concat))
(defun rhash-concat (rhash hash1 hash2 hash2-length)
  (declare ((unsigned-byte 32) hash1 hash2)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) hash2-length))
  (let* ((modulus (rhash-modulus rhash)))
    (mod (+ hash2
            (* hash1 (aref (rhash-powers rhash) hash2-length)))
         modulus)))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (unsigned-byte 62) &optional)) rhash-vector-hash)
         (inline rhash-vector-hash))
(defun rhash-vector-hash (rhash vector &key (key #'char-code))
  "Returns the hash code of VECTOR w.r.t. the moduli and bases of RHASH."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           (vector vector)
           (function key))
  (let* ((mod (rhash-modulus rhash))
         (base (aref (rhash-powers rhash) 1))
         (size (length vector))
         (lower 0))
    (declare ((unsigned-byte 32) lower))
    (dotimes (i size)
      (setf lower (+ (mod (* base lower) mod)
                     (mod (the fixnum (funcall key (aref vector i))) mod))))
    lower))

(defun rhash-get-lcp (rhash1 start1 rhash2 start2)
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start1 start2))
  (assert (= (rhash-modulus rhash1) (rhash-modulus rhash2)))
  (assert (and (< start1 (length (rhash-cumul rhash1)))
               (< start2 (length (rhash-cumul rhash2)))))
  (let ((max-length (min (- (length (rhash-cumul rhash1)) start1 1)
                         (- (length (rhash-cumul rhash2)) start2 1))))
    (declare (optimize (safety 0)))
    (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 max-length))
           (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 max-length)))
        max-length
        (labels ((bisect (ok ng)
                   (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) ok ng))
                   (if (<= (- ng ok) 1)
                       ok
                       (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                         (if (= (rhash-query rhash1 start1 (+ start1 mid))
                                (rhash-query rhash2 start2 (+ start2 mid)))
                             (bisect mid ng)
                             (bisect ok mid))))))
          (bisect 0 max-length)))))

def z_algorithm(s)
  n = s.size
  return [] if n == 0
 
  z = [0]
  j = 0
  1.upto(n-1){ |i|
    k = j+z[j] <= i ? 0 : j+z[j]-i < z[i-j] ? j+z[j]-i : z[i-j]
    k += 1 while i+k<n && s[k]==s[i+k]
    j = i if j+z[j] < i+k
    z << k
  }
  z[0] = n
  return z
end

def z_algorithm(s)
  n = s.size
  return [] if n == 0

  z = [0]*n
  z[0] = n
  i, j = 1, 0
  while i < n
    j += 1 while i+j<n && s[j]==s[i+j]
    z[i] = j
    if j == 0 then
      i += 1
      next
    end
    k = 1
    while i+k<n && k+z[k]<j
      z[i+k] = z[k]
      k += 1
    end
    i += k
    j -= k
  end
  return z
end

let readString () = Scanf.scanf " %s" (fun s -> s)

let borders s =
  let n = String.length s in
  let b = Array.make (n+1) (-1) in
  for i=0 to n-1 do
    let j = ref b.(i) in
    while !j >= 0 && s.[!j] <> s.[i] do
      j := b.(!j)
    done;
    b.(i+1) <- !j+1
  done;
  b

type result = [`Unknown | `Cycle | `Length of int]
type knownResult = [`Cycle | `Length of int]

let rec compare (a: result) (b: result) =
  match (a, b) with
  | (`Unknown, `Unknown) -> 0
  | (`Cycle, `Cycle) -> 0
  | (`Length x, `Length y) -> Pervasives.compare x y
  | (`Unknown, _) -> -1
  | (`Cycle, _) -> 1
  | _ -> -(compare b a)

let solve s t : knownResult =
  let n = String.length s in
  let m = String.length t in
  let b = borders t in
  let yes = Array.make n false in
  let j = ref 0 in
  for i=0 to n+m-2 do
    while !j >= 0 && (!j >= m || t.[!j] <> s.[i mod n]) do
      j := b.(!j)
    done;
    incr j;
    if !j = m then yes.(i+1-m) <- true
  done;
  let plen: result array = Array.make n `Unknown in
  let rec calc ?(start = None) i : knownResult =
    let i0 = match start with None -> i | Some i0 -> i0 in
    match plen.(i) with
    | `Unknown ->
        begin
          let ans =
            if start <> None && i = i0 then `Cycle
            else if not yes.(i) then `Length 0
            else
              match calc ~start:(Some i0) ((i + m) mod n) with
              | `Cycle -> `Cycle
              | `Length x -> `Length (1 + x)
          in
          plen.(i) <- ans;
          ans
        end
    | `Cycle -> `Cycle
    | `Length x -> `Length x
  in
  let res: knownResult ref = ref (`Length 0) in
  for i=0 to n-1 do
    let x = calc i in
    if compare (!res :> result) (x :> result) < 0 then res := x
  done;
  match !res with
  | `Cycle -> `Cycle
  | `Length x -> `Length x

let main () =
  let s = readString () in
  let t = readString () in
  Printf.printf "%d\n" (match solve s t with `Cycle -> -1 | `Length x -> x)

proc lt_substr(s:string, t:string, si:int = 0,ti:int = 0):bool =
  var
    sn = s.len
    tn = t.len
    si = si
    ti = ti
  while si < sn and ti < tn:
    if s[si] < t[ti]: return true
    if s[si] > t[ti]: return false
    si += 1; ti += 1
  return si >= sn and ti < tn

type SuffixArray = object
  s:string
  SA:seq[int]

proc newSuffixArray(s:string):SuffixArray = 
  var
    n = s.len
  result = SuffixArray()
  result.s = s
  result.SA = newSeq[int](n)
  for i in 0..<n:
    result.SA[i] = i
  proc cmp_sa(a,b:int):int =
    return
      if s[a] == s[b]: cmp[int](b,a)
      else: cmp[char](s[a],s[b])
  result.SA.sort(cmp_sa)
  var
    classes = newSeq[int](n)
    c = map(s,proc (x:char):int = ord(x))
    cnt:seq[int]
    len = 1
  while len < n:
    for i in 0..<n:
      if i > 0 and c[result.SA[i - 1]] == c[result.SA[i]] and result.SA[i - 1] + len < s.len and c[result.SA[i - 1] + len div 2] == c[result.SA[i] + len div 2]:
        classes[result.SA[i]] = classes[result.SA[i - 1]];
      else:
        classes[result.SA[i]] = i;
    cnt = toSeq(0..<n)
    for i in 0..<n:
      c[i] = result.SA[i]
    for i in 0..<n:
      var s1 = c[i] - len
      if s1 >= 0: result.SA[cnt[classes[s1]]] = s1;cnt[classes[s1]] += 1
    classes.swap(c);
    len *= 2

proc `[]`(self:SuffixArray, k:int):int =
  return self.SA[k]

proc size(self:SuffixArray):int =
  return self.s.len


proc lowerBound(self:SuffixArray, t:string):int =
  var
    low = -1
    high = self.size
  while high - low > 1:
    var mid = (low + high) div 2
    if lt_substr(self.s, t, self.SA[mid]): low = mid
    else: high = mid
  return high

proc lowerUpperBound(self:SuffixArray, t:string):(int,int) =
  var
    idx = self.lowerBound(t)
    low = idx - 1
    high = self.size
    t = t
  t[^1] = chr(ord(t[^1]) + 1)
  while high - low > 1:
    var mid = (low + high) div 2
    if lt_substr(self.s, t, self.SA[mid]): low = mid
    else: high = mid
  t[^1] = chr(ord(t[^1]) - 1)
  return (idx, high)

    echo i, ": ", self.s.substr[self.SA[i]..<self.s.len]

proc initBellmanFord(n:int):BellmanFord =
  result = BellmanFord(
    E:newSeq[Edge](),
    n:n,

    neg:newSeq[bool](n)

  for d in result.dist.mitems: d = 1 shl 60
proc add_edge(this:var BellmanFord, frm,to,cap:int) =
  this.E.add((frm, to, cap))
proc build(this:var BellmanFord, src:int) =
  this.dist[src] = 0
  for _ in 1..<this.n:
    for e in this.E:
      this.dist[e.to] = min(this.dist[e.to], this.dist[e.frm]+e.cap)
  for _ in 0..<this.n:
    for e in this.E:
      if this.neg[e.frm] or this.dist[e.to] > this.dist[e.frm]+e.cap:
        this.neg[e.to] = true

  (this.dist[dst], not this.neg[dst])

# 計算量はうまくできてれば、O(n)のはず。
type
  SAType = enum L, LMS, S
  SuffixArraySAIS = object
    sa: seq[int]
    s: seq[int]
    t: seq[SAType]
    n: CountTable[int]
    b: OrderedTable[int, int]
proc build(self: var SuffixArraySAIS)
proc initSuffixArraySAIS(s: seq[int]): SuffixArraySAIS =
  result = SuffixArraySAIS(
    sa: newSeq[int](len(s)+1),
    s: s,
    t: newSeq[SAType](len(s)+1),
    n: initCountTable[int](),
    b: initOrderedTable[int, int]())
  result.s.add(low(int))
  for c in result.s:  # 以前のバージョンだとtoCountTableが使えないので。
    inc result.n, c
  for k,v in result.n:
    result.b[k] = v
  result.b.sort(system.cmp)
  var acc = 0
  for k,v in result.b:
    acc += v
    result.b[k] = acc
  result.build
proc updateLS(self:var SuffixArraySAIS) =
  self.t[^1] = S
  for i in countdown(high(self.t)-1, 0):
    if self.s[i] < self.s[i+1]:
      self.t[i] = S
    elif self.s[i] > self.s[i+1]:
      self.t[i] = L
    else:
      self.t[i] = self.t[i+1]
  for i in countdown(high(self.t), 1):
    if self.t[i-1] == L and self.t[i] == S:
      self.t[i] = LMS
proc inducedSort(self:var SuffixArraySAIS, lmss:seq[int]) =
  var cnts = initCountTable[int]()
  for i,_ in self.sa:
    self.sa[i] = -1
  for i in countdown(high(lmss), 0):
    let lms = lmss[i]
    let e = self.s[lms]
    inc cnts, e
    self.sa[self.b[e]-cnts[e]] = lms
  for k,v in cnts.mpairs: v = 0 # clear使えないとか冗談やめて。
  for i,x in self.sa:
    if x <= 0 or self.t[x-1] != L:
      continue
    let e = self.s[x-1]
    inc cnts, e
    self.sa[self.b[e]-self.n[e]+cnts[e]-1] = x-1
    if self.t[x] == LMS and x != high(self.sa):
      self.sa[i] = -1
  for k,v in cnts.mpairs: v = 0 # clear使えないとか冗談やめて。
  for i in countdown(high(self.sa), 0):
    let x = self.sa[i]
    if x <= 0 or self.t[x-1] == L:
      continue
    let e = self.s[x-1]
    inc cnts, e
    self.sa[self.b[e]-cnts[e]] = x-1
proc sortLMS(self:var SuffixArraySAIS, lmss, lms_sa:seq[int]): seq[int] =
  var
    nums = newSeq[int](len(self.sa))
    num = 1
  nums[lms_sa[0]] = num
  for i in 1..high(lms_sa):
    let (p, q) = (lms_sa[i-1], lms_sa[i])
    var
      d = 0
      diff = true
    while self.s[p+d] == self.s[q+d]:
      if (self.t[p+d]==LMS or self.t[q+d]==LMS) and d>0:
        diff = false       
        break
      inc d
    if diff:  inc num
    nums[q] = num
  if num != len(lms_sa):
    var sa = initSuffixArraySAIS(nums.filterIt(it >= 1))
    # [ada, aca, ada, aba] -> [3, 2, 3, 1] -> [3, 1, 2, 0]
    # echo sa.s
    # echo sa.sa
    return sa.sa[1..high(sa.sa)].mapIt(lmss[it])
  else:
    result = newSeq[int](len(lms_sa)) 
    # echo lmss
    # echo lms_sa
    # echo nums
    for lms in lmss:
      result[nums[lms]-1] = lms
    return result
proc build(self: var SuffixArraySAIS) =
  self.updateLS
  let lmss = toSeq(0..high(self.s))
               .filterIt(self.t[it] == LMS)
  self.inducedSort(lmss)
  # echo "after first induced sort"
  # echo self.s
  # echo self.sa
  let sorted_lmss = self.sortLMS(lmss, self.sa.filterIt(self.t[it] == LMS))
  # echo "after sort lms"
  # echo sorted_lmss
  self.inducedSort(sorted_lmss)
proc lt(self:SuffixArraySAIS, t:seq[int], si,ti:int): bool{.inline} =
  let
    sn = len(self.s)
    tn = len(t)
  var
    (si, ti) = (si, ti)
  while si < sn and ti < tn:
    if self.s[si] < t[ti]:
      return true
    elif self.s[si] > t[ti]:
      return false
    inc si; inc ti
  return si==sn and ti<tn
proc lowerBound(self:SuffixArraySAIS, t:seq[int]): int =
  var (lo, hi) = (0, len(self.s))
  while lo+1 < hi:
    let mid = (lo + hi) div 2
    if self.lt(t, self.sa[mid], 0):
      lo = mid
    else:
      hi = mid
  return hi
proc upperBound(self:SuffixArraySAIS, t:seq[int]): int =
  var t = t
  inc t[^1]
  self.lowerBound(t)
proc count(self:SuffixArraySAIS, t:seq[int]): int =
  self.upperBound(t) - self.lowerBound(t)

### Topological Sort ###
type TopologicalSort = object
    G: seq[seq[int]]
    ns, vs: seq[int]
proc initTopologicalSort(n:int): TopologicalSort =
  TopologicalSort(
    G: newSeqWith(n, newSeq[int]()),
    ns: newSeq[int](n),
    vs: newSeq[int]()
  )
proc add_edge(self:var TopologicalSort, u,v:int) =
  self.G[u].add(v)
  inc self.ns[v]
proc build(self:var TopologicalSort): bool =
  var
    st = newSeq[int]()
    ns = self.ns
  for i,n in ns:
    if n == 0:
      st.add(i)
  while len(st) > 0:
    let v = st.pop
    self.vs.add(v)
    for u in self.G[v]:
      dec ns[u]
      if ns[u] == 0:
        st.add(u)
  return len(self.G) == len(self.vs)
